title: Prepare a branded raster asset
summary: Trim transparent padding, optionally apply one explicit projective mapping, normalize dimensions, and place a caller-supplied brand or authorization mark.

stages.title: Trim transparent padding
stages.purpose: Remove only transparent outer pixels before later geometry and sizing operations.

stages.title: Render explicit perspective
stages.purpose: Apply only a caller-supplied ProjectiveSpec after trimming and before final sizing.
stages.condition: Run when input.projective is present; otherwise report the stage as skipped.

stages.title: Normalize output dimensions
stages.purpose: Render the latest successful intermediate raster to the exact requested width and height using the explicit fit mode; when the optional projective stage runs, its output is the intermediate.

stages.title: Apply supplied brand mark
stages.purpose: Place the caller-supplied logo or authorization mark using explicit anchor, margins, opacity, and maximum width.

completion.description: The requested PNG exists at exact dimensions, preserves any explicit projective mapping, and contains the supplied mark at the reported placement.

errors.description: The Procedure input is outside the portable contract.
The source or mark does not exist in the granted workspace.
A path violates the explicit workspace grant.
Transparent-bound trimming could not complete, including an all-transparent source.
The supplied ProjectiveSpec or projective render failed.
The supplied mark could not be placed under the requested geometry.
The final output exists and overwrite was not authorized.
A bound provider or adapter failed safely outside a more specific error.
